paragraphs.text: Rishada is a port city on the plane of Mercadia , located due east of Mercadia City .

This seaside city is a province of sorts to Mercadia, filled with markets of its own, though not on the grand scale of the latter. Rishada is inhabited by mariners and pirates. At one point, the Rishadans and the Saprazzans further out to sea were in a state of hostility, though this was resolved in the revolution against the Mercadians.
In 4205 AR , Hanna , Sisay , Orim , and an escort of Mercadian ambassadors traveled to Rishada and booked a ship to sail to Saprazzo .
